assumptions: Client will choose and complete merchant onboarding with the payment gateway (Razorpay/Paytm/Cashfree) — agency implements integration
WhatsApp Business templates will be approved by Meta; template approval and phone-number verification timelines are client-dependent
MVP delivered in English only; Marathi/Hindi localisation deferred to a later sprint
Client will provide branding assets and initial salon data for the pilot (we do not bulk-enter hundreds of salons)
Client owns App Store & Play Store accounts and merchant accounts; agency will assist with submissions but not create merchant accounts

drivers: Two native mobile apps + responsive web dashboard increases platform work and QA
UPI payments + WhatsApp Business integration require gateway setup, reconciliation and template approval
Booking concurrency (preventing double-booking) and reliable payment-confirmation flows need careful backend design
Pilot scale (5–50 salons) keeps infra simple but still needs admin, logging and basic audit trails
